title: Three Seals, One Door
openingText: Blake is leaning on a toll-post that carries three separate charter seals, all valid, all voiding the other two. 'Nobody can collect here without admitting the other two exist,' he says happily. 'So nobody does. I find that sort of gap very habitable. What have you got?'
dialogueWalkaway: No deal, no hard feelings, no protection either. Watch the second gatehouse.
dialogueAccept: Done. And you never heard the name of the man who arranged it.
confidence: He is already selling the same information to somebody else, tonight.

clauses.text: Blake loses your column from three sets of toll records. Nobody knows you passed.
The names of everyone who has asked after you in the Reach this month.
Blake's people know where the Charter parks its provisions. He will draw you a map.
You carry a small sealed package two towns north. Do not open it.
The gap in the patrol rota, and the hour it opens
You look the other way, once, when asked
